subject: Constrictor Health POC — token budget & peak TPS confirmation
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Green <alex.green@constrictorhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 31 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Constrictor Health POC — token budget & peak TPS confirmation

Hi Alex — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and a couple of clarifying asks so we can lock the POC scope and pricing band: 

Summary of what we heard (please confirm or correct):
- Expected monthly token volume (range): ~150,000,000 tokens (we discussed a 120M–180M range)
- Typical request mix: interactive chat + single-turn summarization; avg tokens per call: ~200 tokens (40 input / 160 output)
- Peak TPS observed/expected: ~60 TPS (baseline steady-state ~15–25 TPS)
- Timing: aiming to start a 30-day pilot in early August if procurement clears
- Priority: cost predictability and latency SLAs for clinician-facing features

Budget / unit-econ targets you mentioned on the call:
- Monthly budget range: $15,000 — $25,000
- Target unit price: ~$120 per 1M tokens (≈ $0.00012 per token)

Questions / asks for you:
1) Please confirm the monthly token midpoint you expect for the pilot (is 150M accurate or should we size to 120–130M?).
2) Confirm peak TPS of ~60 or provide the expected worst-case TPS for 95th percentile traffic.
3) Procurement timeline / PO requirements (we can accept a short pilot SOW + a capped credit if procurement needs more time).

Next steps we propose after you confirm numbers:
- Redwood to send a short MSA addendum + pilot SOW and SOC2 summary
- Solutions team (cc Marissa) will scope resource needs for sustaining 60 TPS peak and propose batching/quantization knobs to hit target $/1M if needed
- Schedule a 30-min kickoff to align integration points (suggest Wed Aug 7 or Thu Aug 8)

I attached the POC checklist and a simple CSV template for you to drop any historical monthly counts (Constrictor_POC_requirements.pdf; constrictor_monthly_usage_snapshot.csv).

If anything above is off, flag it in reply and we’ll update the plan. Thanks — appreciate the time today.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0183

Attachment: Constrictor_POC_requirements.pdf (1 page summary)
Attachment: constrictor_monthly_usage_snapshot.csv (sample schema)

From: Alex Green <alex.green@constrictorhealth.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 31 Jul 2028 12:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Constrictor Health POC — token budget & peak TPS confirmation

Thanks Soojin — good summary. A few updates from our side after checking with infra: 
- Monthly token expected: plan to size the pilot at ~130,000,000 tokens (we're conservative for the POC; long-term could trend toward 160–170M)
- Avg tokens per call: closer to 120 tokens (we have more short summarization jobs than I initially described)
- Peak TPS: our headroom target is 48 TPS (95th percentile spikes), sustained baseline ~18 TPS
- Budget cap for pilot: $20,000 for the month; we’d like to keep unit economics <= $140 per 1M tokens for the pilot (higher SLA / lower latency premium is acceptable if we can stay near that target)

Procurement note: purchasing team wants a one-page SOW and SOC2 evidence; they can get a PO within 2 weeks provided the SOW matches the pilot scope.

Happy to kick off Aug 7 — Wed looks good from our side. I attached a short usage export from our staging environment to help with sizing.

Thanks,
Alex Green
Head of AI Platforms | Constrictor Health
alex.green@constrictorhealth.com
Attachment: CH_staging_usage_export_Jul.csv

Alex — perfect, thanks for the clarifications. Confirming what we’ll use for pilot scope: 
- Pilot monthly tokens: 130,000,000 tokens
- Avg tokens/call we’ll size for: 120 tokens => ~1.08M calls/month (useful for routing/kv cache sizing)
- Peak TPS to support (95th pctl): 48 TPS; baseline 18 TPS
- Pilot budget cap: $20,000; target unit price for the pilot: $140 per 1M tokens (Redwood will model options to get cost closer to your long-term target)

Immediate next steps: 
- Redwood to send pilot SOW + SOC2 summary by EOD tomorrow (Marissa will draft technical scope)
- Solutions (Marissa) to propose runtime config and a performance plan to meet 48 TPS with acceptable latency and token efficiency (batching, prefix caching, light quantization where applicable)
- Schedule kickoff: I’ll send a calendar invite for Wed Aug 7, 10am PT; please reply if that conflicts

I also want to propose a pilot onboarding credit to accelerate evaluation — draft proposal: 30% credit off list hosted token price for the first 30 days (applied to usage up to 150M tokens). I’ll surface margin impact to Karthik and loop back with approved concession. If that sounds reasonable I’ll include it in the SOW.

Thanks — looking forward to running this with you.

Best,
Soojin

Date: Tue, 31 Jul 2028 16:41:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: Constrictor POC — ask for onboarding credit approval / margin impact

Karthik / Marissa — quick internal:

Constrictor confirmed pilot sizing and commercial constraints:
- Pilot tokens: 130M / month
- Peak target: 48 TPS (95th pctl)
- Budget cap: $20k for the pilot
- Customer target unit price: <= $140 per 1M tokens for pilot

I proposed a 30% onboarding credit off list hosted token price for the first 30 days (applied up to 150M tokens) to hit their budget cap and accelerate PO. Rough math on impact (approx):
- List cost (modeled): $200 per 1M tokens → list cost for 130M = $26,000
- 30% credit → effective first-month revenue = $18,200 (meets their $20k cap)
- Incremental concession vs list: $7,800

Requesting approval to include the 30% credit in the pilot SOW. If you prefer a smaller concession, suggest 20% and we’ll adjust the SOW and note the renewal/rollover pricing to standard bands. Also need sign-off to loop Legal to fast-track SOW + short MSA addendum.

If approved I’ll finalize SOW and send to Alex tomorrow afternoon.

Thanks,
Soojin
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.ai
